protocol.selection: Maximum worst-development-week net; fixed before validation; no parameter search
protocol.gate: Each dev fold >=10 trades and positive net; validation >=30 trades, positive net, PF>=1.15, daily bootstrap lower95>0, doubled-cost same-trade net>0
protocol.fill_model: 5bps taker per fill, 4bps spread, 2bps slippage per side; actual funding; next-minute entry; stop-first ties
protocol.evidence: Retrospective untouched interval; hypotheses inspired by literature, not replications or profit forecasts

uncertainty.method: IID resampling of whole UTC days, preserving within-day trade correlation; few days limits confidence

same_trade_stress.method: Same positions, size and exit timestamps; double fees/adverse slippage. Not a replay of changed stops or liquidity.
